articles.title: The right to vote is not a gift from the government
articles.summary: The MPTC and ZPTC polls are not conducted by the ECI. Articles 243K and 243ZA vest panchayat and municipal elections in the State Election Commission (SEC). articles.title: Gangster Vishal Gupta arrested in Tamil Nadu after 1,900km chase
articles.summary: Vishal Gupta, a twenty-five-year-old gangster facing multiple narcotics offences under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act, was arrested in Rameswaram on Saturday. articles.title: Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann flags off 100 minibuses to link villages with cities

articles.title: Karnataka CM Shivakumar says government will not take sides in sugar industry dispute
articles.summary: Recalling the previous government’s decision to raise the State Advised Price (SAP) of sugarcane to Rs 3,300 per tonne, he said the cost was to be shared between the state government and sugar mills. Nearly 80% of factories had made the payments, but some failed to comply and approached the courts, weakening farmers’ trust in the industry.

articles.title: Indian opposition draws inspiration from student protests leading to defeat in Serbia
articles.summary: Serbia has provided the Indian opposition with a new international case study after a student-backed movement defeated the ruling alliance in October 2026. The protests began following a tragic railway station canopy collapse in Novi Sad in November 2024 that killed sixteen people. The student movement successfully translated public anger into an electoral platform, securing a majority in parliament.

articles.title_hi: IND vs NZ: भारत के पूर्व सलामी बल्लेबाज रमेश का कहना है कि वैभव नंबर 3 पर 'घबराया' था
articles.summary_hi: 15 वर्षीय वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने स्थान बदलने के बाद न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ नंबर 3 पर सिर्फ 4 रन बनाए। पूर्व सलामी बल्लेबाज सदगोप्पन रमेश ने घबराहट का हवाला दिया। तिलक वर्मा के 51*(26) की बदौलत भारत ने फिर भी 181 रन का पीछा करते हुए 4 विकेट से जीत हासिल की। पाकिस्तान के खिलाफ एशियाई खेलों 2026 के स्वर्ण पदक मैच के बाद भारत के चार टी20 मैचों में चूकने के बाद वैभव सूर्यवंशी आखिरकार खेले।
articles.title_hinglish: IND vs NZ: bharata ke purva salami ballebaja ramesha ka kahana hai ki vaibhava nanbara 3 para 'ghabaraya' tha
articles.summary_hinglish: 15 varshiya vaibhava suryavanshi ne sthana badalane ke bada nyujilainda ke khilapha nanbara 3 para sirpha 4 rana banae। purva salami ballebaja sadagoppana ramesha ne ghabarahata ka havala diya। tilaka varma ke 51*(26) ki badaulata bharata ne phira bhi 181 rana ka pichha karate hue 4 viketa se jita hasila ki। pakistana ke khilapha eshiyaee khelon 2026 ke svarna padaka maicha ke bada bharata ke chara ti20 maichon men chukane ke bada vaibhava suryavanshi aakhirakara khele।

articles.title: Pradeep Gyawali Criticises Finance Minister Remarks on India
articles.summary: Former foreign minister Pradeep Gyawali criticized Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle on October twenty sixth for stating that anti-India nationalism in Nepal has ended. Wagle made the remarks at a summit in New Delhi. Gyawali stated the comments damaged national dignity and urged open discussion on unresolved bilateral issues including border disputes and trade deficits.
articles.title_hi: प्रदीप ग्यावली ने भारत पर वित्त मंत्री की टिप्पणियों की आलोचना की
articles.summary_hi: पूर्व विदेश मंत्री प्रदीप ग्यावली ने 26 अक्टूबर को वित्त मंत्री स्वर्णिम वागले की यह कहने के लिए आलोचना की कि नेपाल में भारत विरोधी राष्ट्रवाद समाप्त हो गया है। वागले ने यह टिप्पणी नई दिल्ली में एक शिखर सम्मेलन में की। ग्यावली ने कहा कि टिप्पणियों ने राष्ट्रीय गरिमा को नुकसान पहुंचाया और सीमा विवाद और व्यापार घाटे सहित अनसुलझे द्विपक्षीय मुद्दों पर खुली चर्चा का आग्रह किया।
articles.title_hinglish: pradipa gyavali ne bharata para vitta mantri ki tippaniyon ki aalochana ki
articles.summary_hinglish: purva videsha mantri pradipa gyavali ne 26 aktubara ko vitta mantri svarnima vagale ki yaha kahane ke lie aalochana ki ki nepala men bharata virodhi rashtravada samapta ho gaya hai। vagale ne yaha tippani naee dilli men eka shikhara sammelana men ki। gyavali ne kaha ki tippaniyon ne rashtriya garima ko nukasana pahunchaya aura sima vivada aura vyapara ghate sahita anasulajhe dvipakshiya muddon para khuli charcha ka aagraha kiya।
